description: Public Art Advisory Committee to appoint Vice-Chair for 2026.

chips.text: Committee member volunteers to serve as Vice-Chair for 2026.

description: City Administration will review advisory committee mandates.
Review will assess original purpose and current relevance.
Committees will provide feedback on their roles.

chips.text: Committee members want more involvement in public art calls and evaluation rubrics.
Artists with public art in Saskatoon are affected by insurance concerns.
Question raised about city's responsibility for public art insurance and upkeep.
Staff will compile all committee feedback for a report back to Council.

description: Committee proposes 2027 budget for mentorship and creative cities.
Includes $8,500 for mentorship program, $1,500 for creative cities.
Submits plan to Standing Policy Committee for approval.

chips.text: Committee member believes the mentorship program is the most meaningful contribution.
Mentorship program supports artists, with two mentees doing projects at New Blanche.

description: Committee recommends holding a private meeting on third-party information.
